svg.text: Collision overlay at 2x — red: footprint slot (half square, 64 x 96 px on screen); blue: base disc 40 x 12 px
Rules resolve per square, not per pixel: the slot is what can be targeted, clicked and blocked.
Art beyond the slot (bow tip in draw/release, the toppled piece in defeat, hop lift) never changes a result.
Design sketch by Claude Code (SVG) under Jiean Yin's direction — not generated art.
